required_preconditions: Fresh read-only server preflight must be performed and pass before any execution Decision
CE-G11A hash-bound correlator binding must remain NOT_AUTHORIZED with authority_effect=false
Proposed release f8107969 and rollback release must be frozen and immutable in the Recommendation
Atomic switch, server gate, controller gate, bounded correlation before rollback, independent vantages, no retry, rollback and post-action verification must all be defined
Execution, deployment, release, Standard Ready, and commercial offering must remain unauthorized pending a separate Human Decision
blocking_reasons: TLS root cause from CE-G8 remains unproven and failure did not reproduce
Release, deployment, Standard Ready, Production, and commercial offering flags are all false
review.rationale: Option A is the only path that respects the current evidence boundaries: it prepares a rigorous, fail-closed CE-G12 correlated redeployment Recommendation with all necessary gates and rollback provisions while explicitly keeping execution unauthorized. The existing evidence (CE-G11A correlator, CE-G11B integration validation, prior FAIL_CLOSED history) is sufficient to construct such a Recommendation but insufficient to execute redeployment because the TLS root cause is unproven, no fresh server preflight exists, and all deployment/readiness flags are false. The CE-G11A binding's deliberate NOT_AUTHORIZED stance correctly defers authority to a future independent Decision, and this non-authoritative posture can and should persist until that Decision is made. Option B is blocked by insufficient execution evidence. Option C is premature given that the proposed release already passed isolated post-merge validation. Option D abandons a viable correlated path without justification.
